# Roleplay Rule 1 - Put Effort Into Your Roleplay
This is an MRP (Medium-Roleplay) server, and the roleplay quality should be higher because of it. Try to be creative with emotes, and hold "Yes, and" conversations that build on top of one another.
You should aim to model your character after a believable, functional adult that is capable of being employed by a company. You should have clear meaning behind all of your character's actions and should not do things "for the bit" if that bit detracts from others' experiences.
If your character is based around a specific gimmick, then you should be creative with it. Please see the below rule for specifics: - [textlink="1.1. Be creative with your gimmicks." link="RuleGimmickCreativity"]
## Precedents
- Characters should remain consistent, and they should be deeper than just a single gimmick or joke. This also goes for character names. - It should make sense for your character to have the role they do. Nanotrasen wouldn't hire an extremely [textlink="incompetent" link="RuleSkillIssue"] [color=#1b67a5][bold]Captain[/bold][/color]. - Don't use text speech like "LMAO" and "BRB", unless you intend for your character to literally say text speech like "LMAO" out loud. - You should make all attempts to be as involved in the round’s story as possible. Behaviors that go against this idea would include sitting in a pile of plushies (or similar childish behavior), fishing in a corner for two hours, sitting in a duffel bag with a [textlink="metafriend" link="RuleMetagameMetafriend"], etc. - If you're making demands or talking to someone in a tense situation that could break out into combat, [textlink="let them finish responding" link="RuleMetagamePowergaming"] before you make your attack.
